a.lede: DreamHost is warning of a data breach after attackers gained access to its File Manager platform for two months and stole customers' FTP/SFTP usernames and passwords. [...]
a.title: DreamHost confirms data breach exposed FTP logins and webmail sessions

b.lede: mSeven Software is warning current and former mSecure password manager customers to change passwords, reset two-factor authentication, and remove passkeys following a cyberattack that reportedly exposed an encrypted customer database. [...]
b.title: mSecure password manager hack prompts password reset warnings
